user_intent: 二氧化碳浓度 应 低于 6%
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境

IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor

IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() oxygen_machine
